QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] Kupo Needs Fuel Badly
QuestInfo.0: Continue your conversation with #bKupo#k at the #bExplorer Base#k.
QuestInfo.1: Kupo wants you to hunt the #rFloras#k on #bColossus East Road#k and collect #b50 Damp Seeds#k as fuel.
QuestInfo.2: You collected 50 Damp Seeds from the Floras. Now Kupo's Ride will have some fuel.

0.0: Hm? Why are you alone? Where's your friend? Ah... #rMotion sickness#k, huh? That's too bad. There's nothing more exciting than the thrill of the ride! Unfortunately, your friend won't be the only one walking. #rWe're done too.#k You see...
0.1: We're out of fuel. We collected all we could before the monsters overran the place, and we used the last of it for the test drive! But don't worry. Someone as tough as you should have no problem collecting more, right? Hahaha!
0.2: My ride is super green. Crystal. Emerald. I use PEANUT OIL to run this puppy. Well, it actually can use just about any plant fuel. Which is why I was hoping you could get some oil from #rFloras#k. Because I ate all the peanuts...
0.3: Think you could handle some #rFloras#k? They hang out around the #bColossus East Road#k, and I only need about 50 #rDamp Seeds#k from them.

no.0: I heard you were crazy about fighting. What a liar...

yes.0: Aww yeessss, this is the stuff! The smell!

item.0: Think you could handle some #rFloras#k? They hang out around the #bColossus East Road#k, and I only need about 50 #rDamp Seeds#k from them.
